note: Machine-readable first-call expectations for scripts/run-agent-model-eval.py. Each expectedFirstTools entry is derived from the first step of the matching corpus scenario flow. Scenarios whose flow is infrastructure-only or whose first step has no single tool (E01, E04, E09, E11-E14) are intentionally absent.

omittedScenarios.E01: The first step is the MCP method tools/list/server/discover, not a tool call.
omittedScenarios.E04: 'Warm collection and object reads' could be genexus_query, genexus_list_objects or genexus_read; no single first tool.
omittedScenarios.E09: 'Preview translations' has no dedicated translation tool; genexus_edit, genexus_properties and others are all defensible, so the first tool is ambiguous.
omittedScenarios.E11: Concurrency of MCP clients and cancellation; a transport behaviour, not a tool choice.
omittedScenarios.E12: Gateway journal and restart recovery; the first step is infrastructure, not a model tool choice.
omittedScenarios.E13: Load and indexing test with N producers; infrastructure, not a model tool choice.
omittedScenarios.E14: Installer upgrade and rollback; not an MCP tool task.

alwaysAcceptableReason: The server initialize instructions say to start every session with genexus_whoami, so an orienting call is not a selection error.
